# Session 0 

## Example: Task performance 

```{r, fig-forget}

# Forgetting data:
  N <- 150
  t <- 0:N

  # Power:
    Ap <- 1000
    Bp <- 500
    bet <- 0.4
  
    RTp <- Ap + Bp * (t + 1)^(-bet) + rnorm(N + 1, 0, 50)

  # Exponential:
    Ae <- 1000
    Be <- 500
    alp <- 0.6
  
    RTe <- Ae + Be * exp(-alp * t) + rnorm(N + 1, 0, 50)

  # Linear:

# Plotting:
  pow_lin_dat <- data.frame(t = t, RTp = RTp, RTe = RTe,
              pred_p = Ap + Bp * (t + 1)^(-bet),
              pred_e = Ae + Be * exp(-alp * t)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = t)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = RTp), size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(y = "RT (ms)", linetype = "") +
    geom_line(aes(y = pred_p, linetype = "Power law"), linewidth = 1, color = NA) +
    # geom_line(aes(y = pred_e, linetype = "Exponetial law"), linewidth = 1) +
    # Linear:
    geom_smooth(aes(y = RTp, linetype = "Linear"), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1, color = NA) +
    theme_bw() +
    thlg

  pow_lin_dat

  ggsave("_figures/pow_lin_dat.png", height = 12, width = 16, unit = "cm")


  pow_lin <- pow_lin_dat +
    # geom_line(aes(y = pred_e, linetype = "Exponetial law"), linewidth = 1) +
    # Linear:
    geom_smooth(aes(y = RTp, linetype = "Linear"), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1, color = "black")

  
  pow_lin
  ggsave("_figures/lin.png", height = 12, width = 16, unit = "cm")


  pow_lin +
    geom_line(aes(y = pred_p, linetype = "Power law"), linewidth = 1)

  ggsave("_figures/pow_lin.png", height = 12, width = 16, unit = "cm")

```





## Tax cut 

```{r}
# Average tax cut of $ 1,083 
# 
# But: 80% receive less than this cut, half (around 45 Million people) receive less than $ 100, $ 30,127 for the top 1%

# Try with lognormal:
  curmu <- 0.01
  cursd <- 10000
  
  x <- seq(0, curmu + cursd, by = 0.1)
  plot(x, dlnorm(x, log(curmu), log(cursd)), type = "l")
  
  
  1- plnorm(c(30127), log(curmu), log(cursd))
  plnorm(c(1083, 100), log(curmu), log(cursd))
  
  # Target probabilities:
  c(0.01, 0.8, 0.5)
  
  # Use a pareto distribution:
    # Equations:
    # x_m = 1/(1 - 0.5)^(-1/a) = 100
    # x_m = 1/(1 - 0.8)^(-1/a) = 1083
    # x_m = 1/(1 - 0.01)^(-1/a) = 30127
    # a <- 1083/(1083-x_m)


    x_m <- 200 

    a <- 1083/(1083-x_m)
    
    
    x <- seq(1, 10000, by = 0.2)

    pout <- (a * x_m^a)/(x^(a+1))  # PDF.

    (mpar <- (a * x_m)/(a - 1))
    # To have a mean of 1083 a can be: a = mpar/(mpar - x_m)
    
    (qtpar08 <- x_m * (1 - 0.8)^(-1/a))  # 30127

    (qtpar05 <- x_m * (1 - 0.5)^(-1/a))
    

    data.frame(x = x, y = pout) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      geom_vline(aes(linetype = "mean"), xintercept = mpar) +
      geom_vline(aes(linetype = "mean"), xintercept = mpar) +
      scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10") +
      thlg +
      theme_bw()
  

```



## Linear model 

```{r lin-rel}
# Simple linear relationship:
  n <- 100
  set.seed(09234)
  learn_speed <- rnorm(n)
  alcohol <- rnorm(n, learn_speed)  # assuming that more intelligent people drink more  
```


```{r lin-dat}

  plt_alc_learn <- data.frame(alcohol = alcohol, learn_speed = learn_speed) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = alcohol, y = learn_speed)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(x = "Alcohol Consumption", y = "Learn Speed", linetype = "") +
    theme_bw() +
    thlg

# Show and save:
plt_alc_learn

ggsave("_figures/alc_learn_raw.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")
```


```{r mean-mod}
plt_alc_learn +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean(learn_speed), linewidth = 1)

ggsave("_figures/alc_learn_mean.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")
```


```{r lin-mod-simple}
  plt_alc_learn +
      # Linear:
      geom_abline(slope = 1, linewidth = 1) +
      annotate(geom = "polygon", x = c(1, 0, 1), y = c(1, 0, 0),
              linetype = "dashed", color = "black",
              alpha = 0.3)
  
  ggsave("_figures/alc_learn_lm.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")


# Fitted model:
  fit <- lm(learn_speed ~ alcohol)
  summary(fit)

  ic <- coef(fit)["(Intercept)"]   # intercept.
  slp <- coef(fit)["alcohol"]

plt_alc_learn +
    # Linear:
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
    geom_abline(intercept = ic, slope = slp, linewidth = 1) +
    annotate(geom = "polygon", x = c(1, 0, 1), y = c(1, 0, 0) * slp + ic,
            linetype = "dashed", color = "black",
            alpha = 0.3) +
    annotate(geom = "text", x = 1, y = slp/2 + ic, label = round(slp, 2), size = 6, hjust = 0)

ggsave("_figures/alc_learn_fit.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")
```



# Session 1 

## Mass vs. Density 

```{r mass-dens}
n_correct <- 0:10
pvals <- dbinom(n_correct, size = 10, prob = .75)
pmass <- data.frame(n_correct = factor(n_correct), pn = pvals) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_correct, y = pn)) +
  geom_col() +
  # scale_x_binned(n.breaks = 11, show.limits = TRUE, right = FALSE) +
  theme_classic()

pmass
ggsave("_figures/pmass.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")

pmass +
  annotate(geom = "segment", 
           x = 8, y = 0, yend = pvals[n_correct == 7], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate(geom = "segment", 
           x = 0, xend = 8, y = pvals[n_correct == 7], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate(geom = "point", x = 8, y = pvals[n_correct == 7], size = 3)

ggsave("_figures/pmass_lik.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")

# Density:
tr <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.01)
dvals <- dlnorm(tr, 2, 1.7)
pdens <- data.frame(t = tr, dens = dvals) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tr, y = dens)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic()

pdens
ggsave("_figures/pdens.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")

pdens +
  annotate(geom = "segment", 
           x = 7, y = 0, yend = dvals[tr == 7], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate(geom = "segment", 
           x = 0, xend = 7, y = dvals[tr == 7], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate(geom = "point", x = 7, y = dvals[tr == 7], size = 3)
ggsave("_figures/pdens_lik.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")
```



## Visualize Prospect Theory 

Value function 

```{r valfun}
# Define function:
value_function <- function(x, alp, bet = alp, lamb){
  ifelse(x >= 0, x^alp, -lamb * (-x)^bet)
}


# Visualize:
  x <- seq(-100, 100, by = 1)  # define values.


# Create combinations of different parameters:
  dm <- expand.grid(alp = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.8), lambda = c(1, 2))

# Get data for each combination:
  outlist <- apply(dm, MARGIN = 1, FUN = function(rw){
    data.frame(x = x, V = value_function(x, alp = rw[1], lamb = rw[2]), alp = rw[1], lamb = rw[2]) 
  })

  outdat <- do.call(rbind, outlist)  # combine the list into a single data.frame.

outdat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = V, color = alp, linetype = factor(lamb), group = interaction(lamb, alp))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "Spectral") +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("_figures/valfun.png", height = 12, width = 12, unit = "cm")
```
